name: Check Disk (CHKDSK)
description:
Check and repair file system errors on a selected drive using CHKDSK.
- Run CHKDSK in online scan mode (/scan)
- Run CHKDSK in offline repair mode (/f)
- Select target drive using browse controls
- Scan for and recover bad sectors (/r, slow, may require reboot)
